migration.name: 20260907090000_add_backlog_awaiting_acceptance
migration.backfill: Adds Prisma/PG enum value awaiting-acceptance and recreates BacklogItem_status_closed_set to include it (legacy blocked retained). Then moves triaging/open/in-progress rows that already have a Workroom.pullRequestNumber or a BacklogItemActivity evidence payload containing /pull/N into awaiting-acceptance, writes a status_change activity, and releases an active work claim. Idempotent: already-awaiting rows are left alone. Does not mark any item done.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: existing rows keep their status; only coding-pool rows with an observed pull request move to awaiting-acceptance. No row is created or deleted. done remains the acceptance terminal and is not written by this migration.

fields.reason: Closed-set lifecycle widened by one operator-ratified value so delivered-not-accepted work is neither open coding demand nor done. Column stays String; CHECK and Prisma enum are the constraint. Legacy blocked remains in the CHECK.
